name: IMO Prelim Past Paper
statement: Grandfather distributed a bag of candies to Donald, Henry and John, who got $70\%$, $25\%$ and $5\%$ respectively. Later Donald gave John 20 candies, and after that Henry and John shared their candies equally. By then Donald had three times as many candies as Henry. The next day Grandfather gave $x$ candies to each of the three persons, and Donald ended up having twice as many candies as Henry. Find $x$.
